name: Futurola x Snoop Dogg | King Size Terp-Infused Blunt Cone | Gin + Juice
description: Futurola x Snoop Dogg blunt cones will have your customers rolling like a double G. These blunt cones are tobacco-free and infused Gin & Juice flavored terpenes. These are king size cones with a filter tip, and are packed into a glass tube.
